test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Treat with a vaccine, usually by injection to promote immunity against a disease
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Inoculate"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Inoculate"** is the most appropriate one word substitute.
 
• **Inoculate:** It means to inject a mild form of the disease into their body as a preventative measure.
 
 
• **Example:** The kids have been** inoculated **against Hepatitis.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Innuendo: **An indirect comment, usually implying something negative, unpleasant, or rude, about someone or something.

 
 
• **Example: Innuendos** regarding his drinking and gambling have hurt his reputation.
 
 
 
• **Innumerate: **without having a basic understanding or lacking of knowledge of mathematics and arithmetic.
 
 
• **Example: **The salesman was an **innumerate **as he was not able to do simple caculations.
 
 
 
• **Innovate: **modify anything that has already been established; introduce something new.
 
 
• **Example:** The desire to **innovate** is constant in the fashion industry.
